_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-auto-docs.ts from its own `TYPES` — do not hand-edit; run `bun run auto:docs`, and `auto:docs --check` fails on a stale copy. The from-within node for the `auto-docs` kind (owner, 2026-10-03: "auto-docs is one declared subgraph, with declared sub-sub-graphs per writer"), the same shape as `docs/docs.json` and `beans/beans.json`: `ContentDirectorySchema` entries whose paths are relative to THIS file's directory. It is generated rather than authored because `TYPES` carries `collect()` functions that cannot live in JSON, so a hand-kept copy here would be a second answer to what types exist.
name: cat-harness

directories.description: Glossary — every term this instance's swimlanes define — the role's title and description, the lane names that bind it, and whether the term has been retired. Indexes the `swimlane-glossary` graph.
Decisions — every DMN decision table a declared `processes` graph holds, with the decision's own name. Indexes the `processes` graph.
Docs — every AUTHORED documentation page an instance publishes, with the title and description its own front matter declares. Indexes the `docs` graph.
Processes — every BPMN process, with its own documentation, its lanes, and the skills its activities name. Indexes the `processes` graph.
Roles — every role a declared `scenarios` graph defines, with the description it declares. Indexes the `scenarios` graph.
Schemas — every schema module a declared `schemas` directory holds, with the first sentence of its module docblock. Indexes the `schemas` graph.
Skills — every skill markdown file, with the description it declares in its own front matter. Indexes the `skills` graph.
Tasks — every named activity in a declared `processes` graph — task, user, service, manual, script and call activities. Indexes the `processes` graph.
Tools — every Tool module a declared `tools` directory holds, with the first sentence of its module docblock. Indexes the `tools` graph.
UML — every UML model a declared `uml` directory holds, one row per model rather than per notation. Indexes the `uml` graph.
